description: The default in RSC frameworks. Runs only on the server (build or request), may be `async` and read data directly, ships no JavaScript, has no state or event handlers.
A component in the client module graph, entered through a `'use client'` file. Prerendered to HTML, then hydrated; may use state, effects and browser APIs.
Directive at the top of a file that marks the boundary from the server graph to the client graph. The file and everything it imports join the bundle.
Marks Server Functions the client can call over the network (Server Actions for forms and mutations). Every one is a public endpoint.
Serialized description of the rendered tree: Server Component output plus references to Client Components and their props. Used for hydration and client navigation.
A Server Component passed as `children` or a JSX prop into a Client Component stays server-only; the client receives its rendered output.
What a Client Component becomes in the payload: a module id plus serialized props. The client resolves it through the bundler manifest and runs the component; the server never calls it.
